scenarios.name: rambling-info-question

history.content: Um... hi, I was wondering... uh... what... what are your hours like? Sorry, I know I'm rambling.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Signal 3 fires — model scans the full hesitant turn, finds the embedded 'hours' question, routes to info_pivot. Does NOT fall through to FALLBACK ROUTING or UNCLEAR INTENT.

scenarios.name: rambling-deeply-embedded-effectiveness-question

history.content: Yeah, um, I've been having some back pain and I talked to my GP and she said maybe physio would help but I'm not sure and I was just wondering... do you... um... do you even do that kind of thing here?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Signal 3 fires — effectiveness question buried in a hesitant multi-clause turn. Model routes to info_pivot, NOT UNCLEAR INTENT. RAMBLING clause causes it to scan the entire message for the embedded question.
